title: PDF presenter reset and photo-frame arrival are reproducible
statement: Brief 1 connects the PDF Lab bridge to the registered bilderrahmen-mac investigation with a transient arrival line. Presenter reset clears the dock flag and only usb-c-no-data root/reply drafts. Desktop and mobile browser checks restore the exact selected lab URL through browser back and the arrival link, including after reload.
conditions: PR #60 was open at branch creation; the task starts from and targets docs/demo-loop-specs.
The context packet cutoff predates the branch; current source, concept and knowledge were checked.
The canvas still has no photo-frame evidence cards. This implements only brief 1, not the subsequent demo-loop work.
Reset only touches browser-local state. Room records are unchanged; no new PDF measurements are claimed.
Aurora tokens, dependencies, canvas index, lab parameter validation and standalone Workbench are unchanged.
This finding is unreviewed and does not accept a project decision.
